Based on my review of the code, this is a minimal bookmark CRUD app: an Express backend with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE for bookmarks (fields: id, title, url, description, tags, createdAt) and a vanilla-JS frontend with add/edit/delete, a substring search, and clickable tag-chip filtering. There is no metadata fetching, no unread/archive/note/snapshot/bundle/import-export/settings/bulk/sort/autocomplete functionality, and no duplicate-URL handling.

REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: no sort control; list is fixed newest-first. REF-BM-23: no markdown note. REF-BM-24/25: no local/PDF or Internet Archive snapshots. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, view, or archive-vs-delete distinction (only permanent delete). REF-BM-29: no bundles. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no display/personal settings."
}
